scripts.build: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../telemetry && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build
scripts.build:offline: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../telemetry && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build:offline && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:pinned-deps && npm run check:ts-imports && npm run check:layer-direction && npm run check:workspace-registry && npm run check:tui-no-ai && npm run check:coding-agent-entry-freeze && npm run check:shrinkwrap && npm run check:install-lock:coding-agent && tsgo --noEmit && npm run check:browser-smoke
scripts.generate:models: npm --prefix packages/ai run generate-models && npm --prefix packages/ai run generate-image-models
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:major: npm version major --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
